scientific_integrity: The all-odd-modulus proof uses exact Ramanujan identities, trace cancellation, classical signed quadratic Gauss sums and CRT local additive twists. Bounded numeric checks only corroborate. Best-of-knowledge priority is qualified by inaccessible historical rank-deficiency work.
scientific_limitations: Only odd moduli, positive DFT sign, and the unit-residue principal compression; nonzero condition number excludes zero singular values. No claim for arbitrary minors.
title: Complete eigenphase spectrum of primitive-index Fourier minors over odd moduli
